items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Even Jimmie Lunceford, Chick Webb and those guys, I can only imagine.

ctx.x: Frank Foster. At any rate they had like three mics on stage. And it was so much better. The band was in control rather than —

And they mixed themselves. When studio players, when I was playing sessions, and we would go out to play gigs with some artist or something, they’d pay to have us come out with them. We could mix ourselves from stage. We were so used to knowing what we sounded like in our headphones in the studio, once we were on the stage we knew exactly — we had our own levels set. They put the mics up but there was not a lot of mixing going on at the console out front. We mixed ourselves. Of course those guys, these are…
Were those the good old days?
